source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The move removes RefCell from the mutex-protected optional server and uses take() at shutdown. The endpoint still uses RefCell, and the original preference observer remains. server() clones the server under the lock and returns ClientClosed when absent. This releases the sender’s reference; it does not prove cancellation of active work, dropping every cloned reference or thread safety. Accepted shutdown later adds observer deregistration as a separate phase. The owned server-field comment still names the removed RefCell form.
title: The shared sender drops its optional server reference without removing every RefCell
